step1_analysis.circuit_type: Ring Oscillator Delay Cell / 2-Stage Amplifier Core
step1_analysis.description: The circuit is a 2-stage NMOS common-source amplifier, likely a slice of a ring oscillator or a buffer core. Transistors XM2 and XM4 act as the active inverting stages, while XM1 and XM3 act as MOS capacitors or dummy loads on the intermediate nodes.

paper_reference.title: High Power Terahertz and Millimeter-Wave Oscillator Design: A Systematic Approach

operating_frequency.description: Target oscillation frequency or bandwidth of the delay cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bandwidth of the extracted 2-stage amplifier with 10k loads. Pole = 1/(2*pi*R*C) ~ 1/(2*pi*10k*50fF) = 318 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without the LC tank or full ring, this circuit acts as a baseband amplifier. The bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant of the load resistors and parasitic MOS capacitances.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = Vrms^2 / R. For 1Vpp swing, Vrms = 0.35V. P = 0.35^2 / 10k = 12 uW = -19 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The testbench uses 10k loads, resulting in low output power compared to a 50-ohm matched mm-wave oscillator.

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain of the 2-stage amplifier.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on typical Sky130 NMOS parameters at 0.7V bias.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the 2-stage amplifier/delay cell, measuring DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 2-Stage Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N2 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 GND N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Biasing and Loads
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
R1 N3 VDD 10k
R2 N4 VDD 10k

* Input source
Vin N2 0 DC 0.7 AC 1 sin(0.7 0.01 10Meg)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1Meg 10Gig
  let gain_db = vdb(N4)
  meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
  meas ac gain_1M FIND gain_db AT=1Meg
  meas ac gain_100M FIND gain_db AT=100Meg
  meas ac gain_1G FIND gain_db AT=1Gig

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 200n
  meas tran vout_pp PP v(N4)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
